summary.text: Christopher Ryan is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 50 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ryan is a labor union leader and former Onondaga County legislator who took office in the State Senate in 2025; he is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Ryan earned a high school diploma from Westhill High School, an associate degree in criminal justice from Onondaga Community College, and a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Buffalo State College.
His career experience includes working as a telephone company lineman and as a union shop steward, executive vice president and president of CWA Local 1123.
Ryan served on the Geddes Town Board and the Onondaga County Legislature before taking office in the State Senate in 2025, succeeding John Mannion (D).

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Cities 2 Committee and is also assigned to the Energy and Telecommunications; Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business; Health; Agriculture; Consumer Protection; and Labor committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Ryan faces James Corl (R / Conservative Party).
